title: An attempt at covering Cocktail Hour by FΛDE
author: Sychamis

upstream.codeText:
/*
FΛDE - Cocktail Hour, covered on bytebeat by Sychamis, October 2024. Update 1.
Original: (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ucL0NTdKdb4)

As far as I'm aware this is the most accurate cover of this tune on bytebeat. It's not perfect though, some effects are a bit off, it doesn't slow down at the end (I may add this in the future).

I didn't manage to find all the chords on my own, so I used the source file of Esteban Trujillo's C64 cover to get them all. It can be found here: https://csdb.dk/release/?id=23
upstream.author: Sychamis
upstream.name: An attempt at covering Cocktail Hour by FΛDE
